backgrounds.description: Mountain campsite, dying campfire embers, tent silhouettes. The night before the teacher vanished.
90s RV interior, narrow aisle, wasteland highway out the window.
Empty freeway, rusted signs, city skyline in the distance.
City streets after all the adults vanished—still cars, scattered debris.
ER lobby, flickering cold white lights, half-empty medicine shelves.
Corner pharmacy, shattered window—antibiotics are the prize here.
Abandoned gas station, pumps dead—gas decides whether you keep moving.
At the end of a distant light beam—a tall transmission tower, nothing on top.
Radio tower roof, campfire under the stars, teens talking late into the night.
Cramped city rental—the normal ending's landing in the real world.
Ten years later, black suits, stone marker—the bad ending's real world.
Hidden ending—characters break the fourth wall and leave the set.
True ending meta curtain call—characters in everyday clothes, standing in light.
Y2K digicam overlook of a hillside road above a city that shouldn't be empty.
Infinite multi-level parking garage—fluorescent hum, no cars that matter.
Empty school corridor, digicam noise, footsteps that don't echo right.
Hollow department-store atrium under sickly atrium light.
Pseudo-documentary ridge—an inverted Tokyo Tower half-hidden in the range.
A ridge line of hung Tokyo Towers in regular intervals—wrong geometry.
